assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Rune Scribe Moonleaf production Seal color master
Primary request: Create one independent Night Owl medallion matching the approved Moonleaf craftsmanship. It must depict a front-facing silver owl as a quiet nocturnal watcher beneath a small luminous crescent moon.
Input images: Image 1 is the controlling Moonleaf style board for palette, metalwork, material, botanical filigree, and finish. Images 2 and 3 are accepted detailed Moonleaf Seal color masters and define the exact family quality, relief, rim treatment, scale, and rendering density. Image 4 is the current simplified Night Owl glyph; use it only for semantic identity and centered silhouette, never for visual quality.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent exterior around the isolated emblem; no scene, no panel, no card, no background plate beyond the medallion itself.
Subject: a distinct centered round-to-slightly-oval deep forest-green enamel medallion with a strong silver rim; a readable silver owl with large eyes and folded wings; one small crescent moon clearly above the owl; restrained leaf accents integrated into the rim.
Style/medium: high-fidelity dimensional fantasy metalwork, carved silver and ivory relief, dark green enamel, cool blue-white highlights, subtle internal shadow, consistent with the accepted Crescentleaf and Woodland Stag masters.
Composition/framing: centered, symmetric, isolated, 1:1 canvas, generous transparent margin, complete silhouette fully visible, no cropping. Keep the owl, crescent, and outer rim bold enough to remain recognizable at 48–64 px.
Lighting/mood: quiet moonlit glow, serene, premium, no harsh bloom.
Color palette: silver, ivory, deep forest green, restrained cool blue-white.
Materials/textures: embossed silver relief, engraved rim, enamel field, crisp antler-thin filigree only where it survives downscaling.
Constraints: actual alpha transparency outside the emblem; exactly one independent emblem; preserve crisp edges, internal shadow, relief, and complete rim.
Avoid: all text, letterforms, glyphs, runes, numbers, logos, UI, buttons, cards, frames, screenshots, scenery, rectangular backdrops, extra animals, multiple emblems, flat line-icon styling, neon mint outlines, watermark.

alphaRestoration.method: ffmpeg alpha merge using the accepted Woodland Stag Seal alpha silhouette

review.notes: Distinct owl silhouette, crescent, full rim, and Moonleaf material identity remain readable at compact size; owner review remains pending.
